title: What is an AI Agent Loop?
description: Explaining how autonomous AI agents work under the hood using a 5-step loop.

scenes.say: An AI agent is not magic. It is just an autonomous while loop.
title: An AI agent is
just a while loop.

scenes.say: Every agent cycle executes five steps: Goal, Think, Act, Observe, and Done.
scenes.title: The Core Cycle

scenes.say: In code, the agent calls an LLM, inspects tool invocations, and executes actions.
scenes.title: The Whole Idea

scenes.say: When the agent runs, it calls tools, runs tests, and catches errors autonomously.
scenes.title: Real Execution

scenes.say: To prevent failure, you must add three guardrails: iteration limits, memory compaction, and approval gates.
title: Essential
Guardrails
cards: Halts infinite loops and prevents cost spikes
Summarizes tool output history to save tokens
Demands confirmation before modifying critical state

scenes.say: Now go build your own autonomous agents. Star the repository on GitHub.
title: Now Build
Your Own
